technique: multi-property tween showcase with bounce, rotation, and elastic movement
description: Animates three boxes independently with distinct easing styles: a bounce scale pulse, a smooth 360-degree rotation, and an elastic positional shift, each staggered by delay.

technique: scroll-triggered card stagger reveal
description: Cards fade in and scale up from below with a bouncy back-ease stagger when scrolled into view, with click interactions triggering a pulse and full rotation effect.

technique: mouseenter/mouseleave scale-rotate-color hover with click spin sequence
description: Animates interactive boxes with scale, rotation, and color changes on hover using back.out easing, plus a click-triggered squeeze-then-spin sequence with chained color transitions.

technique: pulsing dot loader stagger loop
description: Animates a row of loader dots with staggered scale and color pulsing that repeats and yoyos to create a bouncing loading indicator effect.

technique: mouse follow cursor tracker
description: A custom cursor follower element that smoothly tracks mouse movement within a defined area, scaling in with a bouncy elastic effect on enter and fading out on leave.

technique: parallax background scroll with content reveal
description: Animates a background element with a slow parallax yPercent offset tied to scroll position while fading in foreground content with a smooth ease as it enters the viewport.

technique: scroll-triggered scale rotation color transform
description: Animates a box from small and red to large, fully rotated, and green as it enters the viewport, with scrubbing tied to scroll position and class toggling on enter/leave events.

technique: svg path shape morphing sequence
description: Animates an SVG path element through a sequence of geometric shapes (triangle, diamond, circle, rectangle) with coordinated fill color transitions using a GSAP timeline and power2.inOut easing.

technique: svg motion path follower with auto-rotate
description: Animates an element along an SVG path using MotionPathPlugin with auto-rotation and a simultaneous scale pulse, with a circular rotation fallback when the plugin is unavailable.

technique: character split entrance with color wave and bounce
description: Splits text into individual character spans, animates them in with a rotating scale entrance using back.out easing, then sequences a color wave pulse and a staggered vertical bounce effect.

technique: sequential multi-box timeline entrance with staggered color pulse
description: Animates four boxes into view one-by-one using scale, rotation, and bounce effects, then spins them all with a staggered rotation and cycles their background color from red to green and back.

technique: motion path follower with SVG morphing and staggered loader dots
description: Animates a circle along an SVG motion path with auto-rotation, morphs an SVG shape through multiple geometric forms with color transitions, and runs a staggered pulsing dot loader animation using GSAP MotionPathPlugin and timeline sequencing.

technique: interactive tween group with scale, rotate, and move
description: Clicking triggers three independent GSAP tweens on separate boxes — scaling, rotating, and moving — each with staggered delays, driven by custom reusable animation hooks.

technique: scroll-triggered card stagger reveal
description: Cards animate in from below with a scale and fade effect using a bouncy back-out ease and staggered timing when scrolled into view, with an additional click-triggered spin and pulse interaction.

technique: static footer component
description: A static React footer component with no GSAP animation, displaying copyright information with a semi-transparent black background.

technique: hero entrance with floating decorative elements
description: Animates a hero title with a spinning scale-in using back.out easing, fades in a subtitle from below, and sets decorative boxes into continuous looping float animations with predefined positional and rotational values.

technique: hover and click interactive element animations
description: Interactive box elements that scale, rotate, and change color on hover with a back-ease bounce effect, and perform a squash-stretch yoyo click with a full 360-degree spin on interaction.

technique: mouse-interactive hover and cursor follower animations
description: Animates elements on hover and click with scale, rotation, and color changes, while a cursor follower with trail effect tracks mouse movement within a designated area.

technique: staggered dot pulse loop
description: Three dots sequentially scale up and change color with a yoyo repeat, creating a pulsing loading indicator triggered by a click.

technique: mouse follow cursor tracker
description: A circular dot element smoothly follows the user's cursor within a bounded area, appearing with a bouncy scale-in on mouse enter and fading out on mouse leave, with a demo mode that animates the follower in a circular path.

technique: scroll-aware navbar hide/show with entry animation
description: A fixed navigation bar that animates in on page load, hides by sliding off-screen when scrolling down, and reveals itself when scrolling up, with smooth scroll-to-section functionality.

technique: scroll-driven parallax background with content fade-in
description: Animates a background layer at a slower scroll rate than the viewport using scrubbed ScrollTrigger yPercent, while fading in overlaid content as it enters view, creating a classic parallax depth effect.

technique: scroll-triggered multi-element reveal with parallax
description: Animates a rotating/scaling box, a parallax background layer, fading content blocks, and staggered card reveals as the user scrolls, using scrub and toggleActions for bidirectional scroll-linked playback.

technique: scroll progress bar
description: A fixed top progress bar that fills horizontally using GSAP to reflect the user's scroll position on the page, with a colorful gradient and instant easing.

technique: scroll-triggered scale rotate color morph
description: A box animates from small red to large green with a full 360-degree rotation as the user scrolls, driven by ScrollTrigger scrub with a bouncy back-out ease.

technique: svg path morph sequence
description: Animates an SVG path through a sequence of geometric shapes (triangle, diamond, circle, rectangle) with synchronized color transitions using GSAP timeline and attribute morphing.

technique: svg motion path follower with yoyo repeat
description: Animates a circle element along a curved SVG path using GSAP MotionPathPlugin with auto-rotation and a simultaneous scale pulse, both reversing with yoyo repeat on click.

technique: character split bounce-in with color wave and yoyo
description: Splits a heading into individual characters that spin and scale in with a bouncy ease, then ripple through a green color wave and finish with a staggered vertical bounce effect.

technique: sequential timeline box entrance with staggered spin finale
description: Four numbered boxes animate into view one-by-one using scale, rotation, and y-offset entrances with overlapping timing, then all spin 360 degrees together with a staggered delay on click.
